playbook.headline: Run /swarm (3–4 workers + verifier) on Gemini (70%) + tap AGY Claude/GPT lane (97%)
guidance: Gemini has 70% left (70% 5h) — fire up /swarm with 3–4 parallel workers + a verifier on Gemini Neon or Hydrogen.
AGY's separate Claude/GPT lane has 97% left (100% 5h) while native Claude & Codex are tight — route Opus-tier planning or overflow coding there.

playbook.headline: Codex low (5% left, resets in 11h) — turn /fast OFF, use Terra/Luna or wait
guidance: Turn /fast OFF immediately — priority speed multiplies burn 2x–8x and only 5% remains before the 11h reset.
Step down to Terra or Luna with low/medium effort, or hold Codex for 11h and use AGY.

playbook.headline: Claude exhausted (42h to reset) — shift Opus/coding to AGY Claude/GPT lane (97% left)
guidance: Hold native Claude until its allowance resets in 42h.
Shift Opus/coding work to AGY's Claude/GPT lane (97% left) right now.
Note: Fable weekly still shows 51%, but the overall weekly cap at 0% blocks Claude until 42h.
